subject: Azure Marketplace co-demo: shadow runbook & decoupled handoff
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@helios-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@stratuswave.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo slots — conflict next week

Hi Evelyn —

Quick note: our primary SI lead for the co-demo (Rahul) is unexpectedly on site with a customer the week of Dec 27 and asked whether we could pull the joint marketplace demo earlier or run a partial session. Helios still wants an AWS/Azure-focused co-sell slot during the last week of Dec but we have a tight blackout across APAC teammates.

Options from our side:
- Move to Dec 21-22 (US overlap) but Helios has a maintenance window on Dec 21 14:00-17:00 PST (limited).
- Keep the existing slot and have a recorded tech segment + live Q&A.
- Run two back-to-back micro-sessions so regional teams can attend.

Can Redwood support a "shadow runbook" approach where Jordan (your SI coordinator) hosts the technical demo, and Helios covers sales/context? We also want a fall-back pre-recording and lab access if live labs fail.

Attaching our preferred time blocks and a tentative attendee list.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, Helios Systems
samir@helios-systems.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: helios-preferred-times.csv
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@helios-systems.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo slots — conflict next week

Thanks for the heads up, Samir — appreciate the options and the attendee list. Short answer: yes, we can do the "shadow runbook + decoupled handoff" model. Proposed plan below.

Plan (high level)
- Dec 21 13:00 PST: Joint intro and business-context (Helios leads) — 15m
- Dec 21 13:15 PST: Technical deep-dive (Jordan hosts; Helios co-present) — 35m
- Dec 21 13:50 PST: Live Q&A + fallback to pre-recorded tech segment if we hit infra limits — 25m
- Post-demo: Provide sandbox lab access (48-hour window) + replay recording and short how-to doc.

Ops notes:
- Jordan will intake the runbook tasks and act as on-stage SI for the technical portion.
- Vanessa: can you own the marketplace listing confirmation (required metadata for Azure)?
- Vivek: please prep the pre-recorded 12-minute tech clip and the lab snapshot that we can hand over in case of lab failure.

Samir, if this looks good I'll circulate a calendar placeholder and attach our shadow runbook draft. Prefer to lock the 13:00 PST slot on Dec 21 to give APAC folks a chance to join in early morning.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood-shadow-runbook-v1.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@helios-systems.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@stratuswave.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo slots — conflict next week

On Mon, Dec 20, 2027 at 11:03 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Samir — appreciate the options and the attendee list. Short answer: yes, we can do the "shadow runbook + decoupled handoff" model. Proposed plan below.

Thanks, team — I'll take the technical lead for the live portion and build the micro-runbook checklist. A few specific asks so I can finalize: 
- Vivek: can you confirm the lab snapshot image ID and whether we can pre-provision 10 concurrent seats for Helios attendees?
- Samir: please confirm if Helios wants us to display any custom telemetry or support agent in the demo UI (we can mask PII).
- Evelyn / Vanessa: do we have a finalized marketplace listing name and short-blurb for the Azure catalog? Azure wants 2-sentence summary by EOD Dec 21.

Fallbacks I'm preparing:
- 12-min pre-recorded tech clip (Vivek will upload) + annotated slide deck (redwood-deck-v2.pdf)
- A short run-of-show ICS file I'll circulate once times are locked.

I'll also create a short Slack channel for on-the-fly triage during the demo (we can invite Helios and Azure PM).

Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Attachments: go-live-fallback-recording.mp4 (placeholder), redwood-deck-v2.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir@helios-systems.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@stratuswave.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace demo slots — conflict next week

Evelyn / Jordan — this all looks good and appreciated. Confirming: Dec 21 13:00 PST slot locked. Helios will lead business intro; Jordan will run the tech deep-dive. We will provide the two-sentence marketplace blurb separately in the next hour.

One last ask: can Redwood share the 48-hour sandbox credentials ahead of time so our engineers can test the flow (read-only) before the session? If not, a test sandbox account with scrubbed data is fine.

I'll upload the final attendee list and the ICS to the shared drive. Thanks for the quick pivot.

—Samir
